title: Heart of the Matter 2
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: The teacher invites participants to explore the concept of the heart of the matter by examining their own experiences with inquiry and self-inquiry, encouraging them to share their insights as an offering to benefit everyone in the group. This process can lead to a deeper understanding of one's true nature and the interconnectedness of all things. By sharing and listening to each other's perspectives, participants can cultivate greater awareness, compassion, and wisdom.
